title: Entitled Blonde Woman Attacks Bar Patrons & Pays the Price
description:
On November 4th, 2023, officers in Ohio responded to a fight that had broken out in the parking lot of a local bar around 01:33 AM. Upon the officers' arrival, they encountered a crowd gathered around a fight in the parking lot. A staff member from the bar was seen restraining a suspect, a 33-year-old woman with blonde hair who appeared intoxicated. Officers quickly intervened to de-escalate the situation.  Despite the officer's attempts to calm the suspect down, she continued to argue and shout at the officers. 

Upon officers speaking with witnesses at the scene, it was revealed that the suspect was involved in a heated argument that escalated into a physical confrontation with another patron.  Attempts by staff and bystanders to de-escalate the situation resulted in the suspect attacking several individuals. Despite the altercation, no one involved in the incident wished to press charges.

The suspect’s aggressive and argumentative behavior led to her being placed under arrest. After securing the suspect, officers placed her in a patrol car for transport to jail. The suspect was charged with Disorderly Conduct.
